verdict.rationale: The CLI ships a documented `skills init [name]` command that creates a new SKILL.md template (e.g. `npx skills init my-skill`). The Agent Skills specification documents that SKILL.md must contain YAML frontmatter followed by Markdown, and that agents load each skill's name and description. It also covers optional fields (license, allowed-tools) and offers a `skills-ref validate` step, so authors don't need to reverse-engineer existing skills. Missing for 10: evidence showing the generated template's actual contents (that it pre-fills name/description), an explicit spec table entry marking name/description as required fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the authoring flow.
